review: W40 final: numerical reliability, contact-sensitive derivatives, executable feedback and useful learning authority

novelty_check.expanded_old_abstract_only_lead: W40-L02 was previously listed, not read in full; this review reads the actual method and experiments.
novelty_check.date_policy: Publication date, preprint origin and actually read version are distinguished. Not all entries were first proposed in 2025/2026.
novelty_check.citation_policy: Primary URLs are durable. Web ref IDs are ephemeral and a parent must open them before citing. No paper implementation or numerical result was reproduced by this literature task.

core.title: ProxQP: an Efficient and Versatile Quadratic Programming Solver for Real-Time Robotics Applications and Beyond
core.publication: IEEE Transactions on Robotics, June 2025; DOI 10.1109/TRO.2025.3577107; initial journal preprint 2023
core.read_scope: Author publication metadata; project-hosted HAL-04198663v2 manuscript (26 September 2023), sections II–III and V on residuals, proximal primal-dual iterations, linear solves, scaling and warm starts. Not claimed byte-identical to final 2025 paper; proofs and all benchmarks not independently checked.
core.method: Primal-dual proximal augmented Lagrangian, semismooth Newton subproblems, explicit residual criteria, Ruiz equilibration and reuse for consecutive QPs.
core.transfer: Useful numerical design reference for separating an internal working-set decision from the final certificate. The reproduced W40 cycling bug should be fixed directly before adding a new solver dependency.
core.boundary: Closest-feasible-QP mode changes the constraints being satisfied. It must not silently relax the original PD/target/TM02 contract. No project-specific speedup or physical stability guarantee follows.

core.title: Real-Time Control-Constrained DDP for Underactuated Balancing of Legged Robots
core.publication: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters 2026, DOI 10.1109/LRA.2026.3723262; arXiv 2608.18552v2, 3 September 2026 (v1 19 August)
core.read_scope: Actual v2 PDF downloaded and main method sections III–IV, Algorithm 1/2, simulation protocol/results and conclusion read. Web HTML/PDF reader returned DisabledError; public PDF download succeeded. No implementation or video inspected.
core.method: APG identifies control-constraint active sets; KKT computes feedforward/feedback; virtual constraints and gap reduction integrate this into feasibility-driven multiple shooting, with forward projection.
core.transfer: Shows why constraint-aware feedback, forward rollout and value recursion must be mutually consistent. Current r29 is an external H-metric projection, not this complete constrained DDP algorithm.
core.boundary: SRBD force-input simulator with a separate controller computer, not verified Go2/TM02 hardware traversal. APG stopping based on objective change cannot replace this project's strict action certificate.

core.title: DR-MPC: Fast and Feasible Dynamics-Relaxed Model-Predictive Control for Legged Locomotion
core.publication: arXiv 2609.20035v1, 17 September 2026; submitted to RA-L, acceptance not verified
core.read_scope: Main PDF sections III–IV, feasibility remark, contact-aligned input parameterization, predictor-corrector stopping/status and experimental comparison/limitations read; code described as forthcoming, not audited.
core.method: Penalize dynamics/friction coupling while retaining nonempty boxes; eliminate swing-force variables, align move blocks with contact switches, and factor a reduced Schur system.
core.transfer: Separate optimization feasibility from physical feasibility. Parallel speedups should target a measured structured workload; keep dense control authority around contact changes.
core.boundary: The paper explicitly does not guarantee exact relaxed dynamics/friction satisfaction. Its force-input SRBD and relaxed constraints are not a drop-in repair for a 12-dimensional PD-target projection; reported 4.4 ms is not transferable.

core.title: Chance-Constrained Convex MPC for Robust Quadruped Locomotion Under Parametric and Additive Uncertainties
core.publication: IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters 10(8):8388–8395, 2025, DOI 10.1109/LRA.2025.3585315; read arXiv 2411.03481v1, 5 November 2024
core.read_scope: Preprint sections III–V (uncertainty propagation, deterministic chance-constraint reformulation, prior-solution tightening, simulation and Go1 hardware); journal metadata checked on author page. Final author PDF exceeds web size limit; not claimed read.
core.method: Propagate state/control covariance under fixed feedback gains and tighten the friction pyramid using probabilistic margins; footstep scheduling and force-to-torque execution are separate components.
core.transfer: After numerical recovery, measure feedback/execution uncertainty and reserve constraint margin according to evidence, rather than equating a feasible nominal action with robust execution.
core.boundary: Gaussian approximations, user-selected covariance and fixed contact schedule limit guarantees. The project must first estimate actual residuals; arbitrary added margin or a universal fall probability claim is unsupported.

core.title: Gait-Net-augmented Implicit Kino-dynamic MPC for Dynamic Variable-frequency Humanoid Locomotion over Discrete Terrains
core.publication: Robotics: Science and Systems 2025, DOI 10.15607/RSS.2025.XXI.069; arXiv 2502.02934v3, 28 May 2025
core.read_scope: HTML sections III–VI and Algorithm 1, network training-data construction, per-step timing update, reference reconstruction, hardware results and explicit NN-SQP sensitivity/preview limitation.
core.method: A network supplies bounded step duration while sequential QPs adjust footsteps/wrenches and rebuild kinematically compatible references. Network timing is not itself a QP decision variable.
core.transfer: Once stable baseline locomotion exists, material history needs meaningful timing/foothold/loading authority. A scalar 2 Hz speed cap cannot directly command millisecond touchdown corrections.
core.boundary: Small humanoid rigid/discrete terrain, not recoverable material. Randomized-duration labels and nominal-duration recovery do not prove globally optimal gait selection or unconditional convergence. Do not expand action space inside an unfinished PPO tail.

core.title: Highly-Efficient Differentiable Simulation for Robotics
core.publication: arXiv 2409.07107v3, 21 September 2026; first preprint 11 September 2024; publication acceptance not verified
core.read_scope: Latest v3 main sections II–V: contact-mode implicit differentiation, collision-frame contribution, kinematic sparsity, timing/estimation/learning experiments and limitations. Appendix proofs were not independently checked, and the complete implementation was not inspected or reproduced.
core.method: Differentiate the contact solution implicitly by active mode, chain geometry/dynamics derivatives, and exploit sparse kinematics instead of differentiating all solver iterations.
core.transfer: GPU diagnosis should separate forward contact disagreement, collision geometry and derivative disagreement. Analytic derivatives may later remove repeated finite differences, but only for the declared same predictor.
core.boundary: Uses a different nonrelaxed NCP engine. Active-mode gradients do not cover mode boundaries; authors report noisy learning from stiff gradients. This is neither a MuJoCo 3.2.3 drop-in nor a reason to change ground truth or announce guaranteed acceleration.

companion.title: ProxDDP: Proximal Constrained Trajectory Optimization
companion.publication: IEEE Transactions on Robotics 41:2605–2624, 24 March 2025, DOI 10.1109/TRO.2025.3554437
companion.read_scope: Official abstract, method overview and implementation availability only; HAL full text blocked by anti-bot page. Not counted as a full-method reading.
companion.transfer: A complete constrained-trajectory alternative if consistent state/contact constraints become the measured need. Not a justification to replace the current controller just to resolve the reproduced face-cycling bug.

software_primary_sources.relevant_sections: Feature parity; sharp bits; batch throughput; SAT versus native MPR mesh collision; solver iteration tradeoffs.

software_primary_sources.title: MuJoCo maintainer explanation of MJX/native discrepancy, issue 1341
software_primary_sources.relevant_sections: Maintainer comments 17 January, 30 August and 3 December 2024: convex collision and line-search differences; early termination affects numerical agreement. This is a diagnostic lead, not proof of the current custom-port root cause.

software_primary_sources.title: Current MJWarp official documentation
software_primary_sources.relevant_sections: Throughput versus latency; differentiability limitation; float32 versus native float64. Current software guidance must not be retroactively attributed to pinned MJX 3.2.3.

synthesis.immediate: Repair the demonstrated working-set condition while preserving original QP and certificate; no need for a solver migration to fix that bug.
synthesis.main_research: Numerical convergence, nominal feasibility, feedback realizability throughout the hold, contact robustness and learned action authority are different layers. Evaluate each with the recorded control/trajectory evidence.
synthesis.gpu: User authorizes expanded isolated G1-G5 diagnostics, resident node/candidate batching, full planner and independent closed-loop experiments, with one evidence-selected alternate architecture; docs/S1_W41_GPU_PLAN.md governs. Unaligned W40 is not a main-line replacement.
synthesis.not_implemented: No cited controller, chance constraint, gait action, implicit derivative or alternative physics backend was introduced by this review.
synthesis.hold_constraints: The current H projection certifies the action at its initial state, while a 2 ms hold comprises ten evolving .2 ms substeps. Proposed r30 must account for input dependence of those states, use a shared causal predictor and distinguish linear-QP, nonlinear predicted-hold and actual-plant evidence.
synthesis.research_authority: After stable traversal, extend material history to physically meaningful timing/foothold/load authority in a new protocol; do not change action space inside the valid W40 tail.

additional_verified.title: Line-Search Filter Differential Dynamic Programming for Optimal Control with Nonlinear Equality Constraints
additional_verified.publication: ICRA 2026 accepted; arXiv 2504.08278v7, 31 May 2026. Earlier v2 read as Interior Point Differential Dynamic Programming, Redux.
additional_verified.read_scope: Primary v2 method, optimality termination, filter line search, conclusion and future work; no benchmark reproduction.
additional_verified.method: Primal-dual interior point inequality treatment with filter globalization for equalities; structure-exploiting DDP updates and local quadratic convergence under stated assumptions.
additional_verified.transfer: If general hold/state constraints require a complete constrained backward pass, this provides a coherent alternative; it does not justify loosening the present QP certificate.
additional_verified.boundary: Local convergence is not global convergence from arbitrary initial states; restoration and hardware NMPC integration remain follow-up topics.

additional_verified.earlier_read_version_publication: arXiv 2504.08278; v2 10 June 2025; formal acceptance not verified

additional_verified.title: Parallel and Proximal Linear-Quadratic Methods for Real-Time Constrained Model-Predictive Control
additional_verified.read_scope: Author project, official paper method and SOLO-12 timing table; no reproduction.
additional_verified.method: Block elimination, parametric LQ subproblems and time-domain parallel decomposition inside NMPC.
additional_verified.transfer: Target measured derivative/candidate/linear-solve bottlenecks rather than equating thread counts with speedup.
additional_verified.boundary: SOLO-12 hardware high-level solve ran on an external M1 Ultra desktop, not onboard NX. Published scaling levels off; numbers are not transferable to this project.

additional_verified.title: Accelerating and Scaling MPC-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Locomotion and Manipulation
additional_verified.publication: arXiv 2606.05687, June 2026; formal acceptance not verified
additional_verified.read_scope: Author project and now-public official code README; update to previously listed reference, not a newly discovered paper.
additional_verified.method: Centroidal MPC training guidance and parallel-in-horizon batched GPU QP, with reward/critic guidance for locomotion/manipulation.
additional_verified.transfer: Useful architectural comparator if whole-body online MPC remains the data-collection bottleneck after stabilization.
additional_verified.boundary: MPC-guided training is not the current RL cap to online nonlinear whole-body iLQG chain. Do not claim a direct solver swap.

additional_verified.title: Terrain-Adaptive Quadrupedal Locomotion Using Model Predictive Control With Impedance Control and SINDy Model Enhancement
additional_verified.publication: International Journal of Robust and Nonlinear Control; early online 14 August 2026; DOI 10.1002/rnc.70700
additional_verified.read_scope: Author institutional record and paper experiment description; update to previously listed reference.
additional_verified.method: Contact/terrain adaptation through impedance/admittance and SINDy angular-dynamics enhancement.
additional_verified.transfer: An example of material-related information reaching a physically meaningful foot-force/compliance interface.
additional_verified.boundary: PyBullet simulation validation, not demonstrated Go2 hardware passage; author public code entry now verified, not executed; not long-term recoverable material memory.

additional_verified.title: Control-Limited Differential Dynamic Programming
additional_verified.read_scope: Author-hosted original PDF; constrained backward stage and free-subspace feedback construction.
additional_verified.method: Box-constrained local control solve and corresponding feedback gain.
additional_verified.transfer: Requires consistent k/K/value recursion when claiming constrained DDP.
additional_verified.boundary: A fixed control box differs from state-dependent PD bounds; constrained feedback rows cannot simply be zeroed for moving bounds.
